title: Updating the exponent register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, replacing coordinate $3$ of its register vector by $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its exponent by $y$.
replaced:
Let a register record have its 15 natural-number coordinates stored in order as a
vector, with coordinate 3 equal to its exponent field. Replacing coordinate 3 of this
vector by a natural number $y$ gives the vector of the record obtained by replacing its
exponent field by $y$.
